purpose: Define explicit machine-readable handling for semantics that cannot be reconstructed from the current canonical source and Contract Format without guessing.

value.name: Detect, expose and resolve semantic gap

gap_classes.format_gap: Required authoritative semantics exist, but Contract Format cannot currently express them without loss or ambiguity.
gap_classes.source_gap: Required semantics are absent from authoritative source material.
gap_classes.traceability_gap: Semantics exist but an explicit canonical hop/reference needed by a generic reader is missing.
gap_classes.identity_gap: A required identity or target cannot resolve deterministically.
gap_classes.topic_gap: Topic membership, inheritance, composition or coverage cannot resolve deterministically.
gap_classes.structure_gap: Required structural dimension or endpoint is missing/ambiguous.
gap_classes.causality_gap: Required machine-significant order, branch, cause, continuation, subflow or resume semantics are implicit.
gap_classes.round_trip_gap: Canonical normalization/reconstruction loses, changes or invents meaning.

value.visibility_rule: A detected gap must remain machine-visible until explicitly resolved. It must not be hidden by prose, projection, defaulting or guessed values.
value.non_invention_rule: A gap is evidence that the canonical model is incomplete; it is never permission for the reader, validator, projector or runtime to invent missing semantics.
value.lock_rule: An unresolved gap that affects active semantics blocks locked status, except a classification intentionally represented as a valid explicit Outsider where the format permits that state.
value.format_evolution_rule: A recurring format_gap is evidence for evolving Canonical Contract Format rather than encoding project-specific exceptions.

value.purpose: Group explicit unresolved semantic gaps discovered during canonical reading, migration, projection, tracing or validation.

invariants.rule: Unresolved semantic gaps remain explicit and machine-readable.
Missing semantics are not silently replaced by defaults.

hard_gates.condition: A known unresolved semantic gap is omitted from validation output.
Missing semantics are invented or inferred to make validation pass.
Contract is locked while an unresolved active semantic gap remains.
Gap record lacks machine-readable affected refs or evidence/reason.
Gap is marked resolved but deterministic reconstruction still fails.

references.purpose: Missing explicit trace hops are classified as traceability gaps.
Active unresolved semantic gaps participate in lock eligibility.

gaps.description: Legacy Topic field operation_refs is preserved in migration evidence; CCF 2.0 does not justify inventing a Link specialization for it.
Legacy Topic field flow_refs is preserved in migration evidence; CCF 2.0 does not justify inventing a Link specialization for it.

prose.summary: Turns every place where a generic reader would otherwise have to guess into an explicit machine-readable semantic gap.
notes: This is the mechanism by which the 1.4 migration can expose missing specification instead of silently normalizing it away.
Pass 8 formalized previously free Flow actor/data/target/condition/payload/result/error tokens as exact owner-scoped member identities while preserving every source literal.

semantics.identity_rule: This member gives an exact owner-scoped identity to the literal Flow token without adding semantics beyond the owning Flow reference field and the preserved source literal.
semantics.interpretation_rule: Consumers may use this identity as an opaque declared Flow symbol. No meaning may be inferred from spelling, whitespace, filename, path or similarity to another symbol.
semantics.authority_rule: A Flow symbol is descriptive/causal model data only and never grants runtime authority, capability, ownership or execution permission.
semantics.scope_rule: Identity is scoped semantically to the defining contract; identical source literals in another contract or another Flow-ref role are not automatically the same semantic identity.
